key_levels.THE_CHANGE_WORTH_INHERITING_BOTH_20DAYS_: The 2026-09-08 brief recorded SPY's 20-day RISING ~+0.23/session and QQQ's ~+0.15/session. BOTH have now turned NEGATIVE -- SPY -0.354/session, QQQ -0.126/session -- on a tape that has barely moved. The cause is mechanical and is exactly what the 2026-08-25T19:00Z rule says to compute: the late-August closes are ROLLING OUT of the window. SPY drops 770.56 / 772.49 / 777.88 / 776.34 over the next four sessions, so its 20-day falls ~1.67 points to 767.03 even if price never moves. A run that reads 'spot 4.98 below a rising 20-day' has the sign of the trend backwards.
key_levels.IS_THE_QQQ_20DAY_STILL_TRADEABLE_AS_A_TR: The same rule says to retire a level that moves more over the intended hold than the trade's own profit target. Applied honestly: a TACTICAL scalp holds hours to ~2 sessions, over which the QQQ 20-day drifts 717.385 -> 717.114, i.e. 0.27 points; a +20% target on a ~0.45-delta QQQ contract needs roughly 1.5-2 index points. Drift is ~15% of the target, so the level SURVIVES the test for TACTICAL. It would NOT survive it for a multi-week CORE horizon (1.59 points over 4 sessions).

key_levels.READ_THE_FWD_PATHS_AS_A_SENSITIVITY_NOT_: ADDED BY THE 13:40Z SIBLING RUN, and it applies to the sma20_fwd_path_if_flat fields republished directly above. Those paths compute only what LEAVES the 20-day window and freeze what ENTERS it at "price stays flat". MEASURED: the 2026-09-08 brief's SPY path was [769.20, 769.21, 769.34, 769.37] -- flat to RISING -- and the average actually printed 769.0530 then 768.6995, wrong in SIGN within two sessions. Root cause confirmed arithmetically: actual closes came in 2.98 and 7.21 BELOW the frozen-spot assumption, giving a predicted drag of -0.5095 against an observed error of -0.5105 -- agreement to 0.001, so the entering leg accounts for essentially ALL of the miss. The paths are NOT wrong and are NOT to be deleted: the leaving leg is real, useful, and the half a run cannot do in its head. They are MISLABELLED. Read them as "where the average goes IF price holds here", re-derive them every session, and never quote one as a forecast. Full write-up and the transferable class: holdings.json _AN_SMA_FORWARD_PATH_IS_A_TWO_VARIABLE_PROJECTION_AND_THE_PUBLISHED_ONE_FREEZES_THE_ENTERING_LEG_2026-09-09T13-40Z.
